title: Hearty Irish Turkey Stew
description: A comforting and nourishing stew made with tender turkey, fresh vegetables, and herbs, perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the turkey neck on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the turkey and set aside.
Add the onion and garlic to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the carrots, potatoes, thyme, and parsley. Cook for 5 minutes.
Add the flour and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Return the turkey to the pot and simmer, covered, until the meat is tender, about 1 1/2 hours.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley.
